entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
King Xian of Zhou, personal name Ji Bian, was a king of the Chinese Zhou dynasty.

Born in an unknown year, King Xian ascended to the throne around 320 BCE and reigned for approximately three years. His reign was marked by significant political instability and power struggles within the royal court.

Despite this tumultuous period, King Xian's rule had a lasting impact on Chinese history, as he oversaw the expansion of the Zhou dynasty's territories and the development of its administrative systems.

The Zhou dynasty would go on to become one of the most influential dynasties in Chinese history, shaping the country's politics, culture, and society for centuries to come.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: King Xian's reign marked the beginning of a period of significant political instability within the Zhou dynasty, which would continue for decades to come. Despite this tumultuous period, his rule had a lasting impact on Chinese history, shaping the country's politics, culture, and society for centuries to come.
